iti30:1.1: 3 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti30:2.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddho katakibbiso
iti30:2.4: so akataṃ me kalyāṇantipi tappati kataṃ me pāpantipi tappati
iti30:2.5: ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā tapanīyāti.
iti30:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
